title: A Small Dog and a Big Star

before.title: A Small Dog and a Big Star
before.text:
A small dog looks at the sky.

He sees a big star. The star is bright.

"Hello, star!" says the dog.

The star does not talk. But the dog is happy.

Every night, the dog looks at the star. The star is always there.

The dog has a new friend. The friend is far away, but the dog does not mind.

"Good night, star," says the dog.

The star shines. The dog sleeps.

before.text: A small moon sits in a boy's cup. It gives a soft light. The boy does not take a drink. He brings the cup out under the dark sky. The moon goes up and grows as it rises. Soon it is high above the house. The boy goes home in its light.

title: The Blue Sock on the Stairs

before.title: The Blue Sock on the Stairs
before.text: A blue sock is on the stairs. Hana walks past it three times. At last, she picks it up. The other blue sock is under a chair. Hana puts the pair away. The stairs are clear, and her feet are warm the next morning.
